rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when citing a source, quotation, or passage.

example.english: When writing a report, remember to cite reliable sources.
example.traditional: 寫報告嗰陣，記得引用可靠嘅資料來源。

rows.note: Use this for officially summoning someone to appear in court or before an authority.

example.english: The authorities formally cite him to appear in court and testify.
example.traditional: 當局正式傳召佢出庭作供。
